whyThreeSeparateEntriesAppeared: readProfilePlugins lists every profile dependency whose installed package.json declares dsh.bundle.patch; the three component packages were previously installed directly from their own plugin dirs (bundles), so each appeared as its own disabled entry.
fix: The components are installed from copies under session-toolkit/plugin/components/* whose package.json drops dsh.bundle (main + dsh.client + locale + icon kept). The pack patch owns the three loader rows, so components load but are not listed as plugins.
